name: lay
_note: a palm resting on the lower front of the bump, seen from the back (refs m3_k_bump): the thumb OUT along the top, apart from the index (an open, resting hand); the fingers a little fanned, not glued; each finger curls just enough that the tips end in a line along the bump's outline, as if they run on round the curve (index and middle, nearest the front edge, curl most). v4's lay (fingers together, an even curl, thumb tucked) read as a mitt 'all together' that did not follow the bump (Harry, v3)
